messages:
alex: Heads-up — I'm planning to change the /generate response shape for multi-turn contexts. Need a quick compatibility sanity check before I open the RFC.

marta: What specifically is changing? full body or just metadata?

alex: Mostly the `choices[]` items: adding `context_id` and moving `finish_reason` into a sub-object. Old clients should still parse, but we might break strict schema validators. Example:```json
{
  "choices": [
    {
      "text": "...",
      "meta": { "context_id": "c-123" },
      "reason": { "type": "stop", "code": null }
    }
  ]
}
```

sam: hmm — adding fields is usually compatible. Moving `finish_reason` name/placement is breaking. Can we keep `finish_reason` at top-level and add the new one as `reason_v2`?

alex: We could. The goal was to namespace reason data for future extensibility. I wanted to avoid duplicate fields.

jamie: Are there clients that rely on exact JSON pointer `/choices/0/finish_reason`? The SDKs do lenient parsing but some internal services use strict schemas in Go.

marta: Yes, internal scoring service reads `finish_reason` via strict JSON schema (gojsonschema). Changing the path would fail validation.

alex: OK — so option A: keep `finish_reason` as-is and add `reason` alongside it (non-breaking). Option B: rename to `reason` and provide a shim for 6 months. Option C: versioned endpoint header and bump to v2 immediately.

sam: Preference for A + incremental doc + deprecation timeline. Simpler and lower risk.

jamie: Agreed. If we do A, can we also add a `Compatibility-Preview: true` response header for beta clients so they can opt into the new shape (non-destructive)?

alex: I like that. Plan: add `context_id` under `meta`, keep `finish_reason` where it is, add `reason` object for future fields. Add `Compatibility-Preview` header opt-in. Document for 3 months, then propose removal of duplicate in 6 months with migration guide.

marta: Two quick asks: 1) add a feature flag so Dedicated tenants can opt-out of preview; 2) list any SDK changes so we can coordinate releases.

alex: Will add a per-tenant flag and a rollout matrix. SDK changes: JS SDK should parse both `finish_reason` and `reason` (minor patch), Go SDK needs schema update (major-ish, but we can keep old pointer for 6 months).

sam: Can CI create a compatibility matrix job? e.g., run strict schema validator against a captured sample for both old and new shapes. cc: @ci-bot

ci-bot: Added job `compat/choices_path_check` to pipeline. It will run nightly and fail if strict validators break. See https://ci.redwood/compat/choices_path_check

jamie: Nice. Also add a deprecation note to the API changelog and schedule a short email to power users 2 weeks before the opt-in preview.

alex: Will draft RFC and include: schema examples, rollout matrix (dev -> canary -> all), header examples, SDK action items, docs PRs, and the 6-month deprecation timeline. Anyone want to review the RFC tomorrow?

marta: I can.

sam: Me as well.

jamie: +1

alex: Thanks. I'll post link here when ready. :thumbsup:
